chapters.title: Welcome to the RNG-Hellscape
chapters.goal: Introduce Artie and his broken 'Crit-Only' status in a high-stakes environment.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie transitions from a mundane office drone to a level 1 glitch in a lethal game world.

bridge.to_next: Artie must find a way to survive his first night with zero defensive stats and a target on his back.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon's Guide to Not Dying
chapters.goal: Secure gear that compensates for a 1 HP build through tactical exploitation of System bugs.
chapters.stakes_shift: Survival shifts from pure luck to the active tactical exploitation of the System's mechanical flaws.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is a marked man in Oakhaven with no protection.
bridge.to_next: Artie enters the Low-Level Crypts to put his new evasion-focused theory into practice.

chapters.title: Math-Boss vs. The Glitch
chapters.goal: Defeat the Floor Guardian and secure a major loot drop to validate the 'Crit' build.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie moves from a struggling survivor to a high-level 'Anomaly' with the power to break boss mechanics.

bridge.from_prev: The Bone Golem stands between Artie and his first major progression milestone.
bridge.to_next: Artie leaves the crypts with legendary loot and a growing reputation that attracts dangerous rivals.

chapters.title: The Capital of Crits
chapters.goal: Navigate the social and political dangers of the capital while seeking a way to stabilize his build.
chapters.stakes_shift: The conflict escalates from physical survival to avoiding detection by the 'System Police' and religious zealots.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is a fugitive from Vane's ego, seeking refuge in the heart of the System's culture.
bridge.to_next: Artie enters the Grand Arena, trading his anonymity for a chance at a game-changing artifact.

chapters.title: The Tournament of Tiers
chapters.goal: Win the arena brackets without taking damage to claim the Shield of Infinite Health.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie becomes a public icon, forcing the System to actively intervene and attempt to 'balance' his existence.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is the underdog entrant in a tournament designed for high-HP warriors.
bridge.to_next: Artie reaches the finals, facing a rigged match against his primary rival, Vane.

chapters.title: The Final Roll
chapters.goal: Defeat Vane in the finals and survive the System's direct attempt to delete the 'Anomaly'.
chapters.stakes_shift: The stakes escalate from personal survival to the stability of the entire game world's source code.

bridge.from_prev: Artie enters the ring against a 'Whale' player backed by System-level cheats.
bridge.to_next: The System crashes under the weight of Artie's crits, leaving him in the wreckage of a broken reality.

chapters.title: Rebooting for the Sequel
chapters.goal: Establish a new status quo in the 'Safe Mode' world and identify the path to the Server Room.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie evolves from a local glitch into the most wanted entity in the multiverse.

bridge.from_prev: Artie and Fizz are stranded in the Null-Zone after the world-shattering climax.
bridge.to_next: Artie begins the long-term quest to reach the Source Code and delete the System Administrator.
